name: kn-unincorporated-business-tax
description: Saint Kitts and Nevis tax on individuals and unincorporated businesses for 2026. There is no ordinary personal income tax: s.3(3) of the Income Tax Act takes persons other than companies out of the charge for income from 1 May 1980, so wages carry no income tax withholding. Self-employed people, sole traders and partnerships not taxed as companies pay the Unincorporated Business Tax (Cap. 18.46): 4% on gross takings from goods less EC$12,500 a month and from services less EC$2,000 a month (IRD forms use EC$37,500 and EC$6,000 a quarter), with quarterly returns and payment by 15 March, 15 June, 15 September and 15 December. Trigger phrases include St Kitts personal income tax, no income tax St Kitts, UBT, unincorporated business tax, self-employed St Kitts.
